page.overview:
Who is Radcliffe?

Radcliffe is a character in Invincible, debuting in Season 3's flashbacks. He served as the director of the Global Defense Agency and was both a mentor and former superior to Cecil Stedman.

Radcliffe appears as a middle aged African-American male. He lacks any hair and possesses weathered features. After an encounter with the Lizard League, he acquired scars on the left side of his face and eye, causing it to remain shut.

His clothing consists of a gray suit with a white shirt, gray tie, and black pocket square.

Similar to his protégé Cecil Stedman, Radcliffe presents himself as a figure of calm detachment and authority, yet beneath that exterior lies a genuinely caring individual. Despite his good intentions and deep empathy, he embraces a mindset of “the ends justify the means” and “the lesser of two evils.” Driven by his dedication to the greater good, he is willing to make morally questionable decisions if he believes they are necessary to protect the planet. With a sharp eye for talent, Radcliffe refuses to let gifted individuals go to waste; instead, he believes they should be “fixed” and directed toward serving the needs of humanity.
